extracted text: The study focuses on developing aluminum alloys with dilute concentrations of Sc and Zr that don't require quenching. Two alloys were developed: Al-0.09Sc-0.045Zr at.% (Alloy 1) and Al-0.06Sc-0.03Zr at.% (Alloy 2). These were cast from 99.99% pure Al along with Al-2Sc and Al-1.6Zr wt.% master alloys. The melting was performed in alumina crucibles at 800°C. The alloys underwent a two-step aging treatment (300°C for 4h and 425°C for 8h) with slow heating and cooling rates to form L12-structured Al3(Sc,Zr) nano-precipitates. The paper mentions commercial alloys AA5083-H131 and AA6061-T6 for comparison. The Al-2Cu wt.% alloy was also used as a matrix material for comparison. Vickers microhardness measurements were performed with a 100g load for 5s. Tensile tests were conducted at a strain rate of 3.3 × 10−3 s−1.
property mapping:
- Microhardness in MPa corresponds to 'Hardness' and 'Hardness UNIT' = 'MPa'
- Yield strength (MPa) corresponds to 'YS [MPa]'
- Ultimate tensile strength (MPa) corresponds to 'UTS [MPa]'
- Elongation (%) corresponds to 'elong [%]'
- AA5083-H131: 'AA' = '5083', 'temper' = 'H131'
- AA6061-T6: 'AA' = '6061', 'temper' = 'T6'
- Al-2Cu corresponds to an aluminum alloy with 2 wt.% Cu
- Al-0.09Sc-0.045Zr (Alloy 1) and Al-0.06Sc-0.03Zr (Alloy 2) correspond to atomic percentages
abbreviations:
- MMC: Metal Matrix Composite
- DCP-OES/DCP-AES: Direct Current Plasma Optical Emission Spectrometry
- Saffil: A brand name for high-purity crystalline alumina fibers
- at.%: Atomic percentage
- wt.%: Weight percentage
- Two-step aging treatment: 300°C for 4h and 425°C for 8h
- Al3(Sc,Zr): A precipitate phase with L12 structure
- H131: A strain-hardened and stabilized temper
- T6: Solution heat-treated and artificially aged temper
weight percentage:
The weight percentages were directly provided in the document:
- Alloy 1: 0.15 wt.% Sc, 0.15 wt.% Zr (nominal), and 0.14 wt.% Sc, 0.15 wt.% Zr (measured by DCP-OES)
- Alloy 2: 0.10 wt.% Sc, 0.10 wt.% Zr (nominal), and 0.09 wt.% Sc, 0.11 wt.% Zr (measured by DCP-OES)
- Al-2Cu: 2.0 wt.% Cu
